1. Behold, thus saith the Lord unto you my servants, it is
    expedient in me that the Elders of my Church should be called
    together, from the east and from the west, and from the north and
    from the south, by letter or some other way.

Having made these reflections upon the great doctrine of “ the gathering,” we now bear testimony of what the Lord has commanded in the last days. We bear testimony that the Lord God hath sent the angel beheld by John in hisapocalyptic vision, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto all people;
